community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The Terran Solar Court has ruled on this question twice. In *In re: Substrate-Adjacent Containment Vessels (3011)* the Court held that 'a sandwich requires intent to consume, and consuming one's grandmother raises separate questions this Court declines to address at this time.' The subsequent ruling in *Nanna v. The Deli Counter (3014)* clarified only that 'the bread is not the problem here.' The post's framing as an 'open question' is therefore slightly misleading — it is a closed question with an answer nobody likes. [1] Terran Solar Court, 3011, full ruling available [2] Terran Solar Court, 3014, dissent by Justice Olamide-Frey ('respectfully, lol') [3] the grandmother has not been consulted and this is the actual issue
